name: accumulator-angular-diagnosis-v1
gap: Explain fixed-wing angular-rate regression in the accumulator candidate

baseline_no_feedback.change: zero and mask recurrent hidden-to-hidden projection; retain current and lag-drive projections

baseline_current_only.change: zero and mask lag and hidden feedback in memory drive; current projection and all acceleration-head lag inputs retained

candidate_matched_projection.change: initialize memory projection to the exact current-feature rows of baseline memory; retain learned accumulators

baseline_cg64.change: 64 PCG iterations per unchanged proposal instead of 16

candidate_cg64.change: 64 PCG iterations per unchanged proposal instead of 16

shared: Load the authenticated initial session; same observations, commands, cache, loss, prior, damping, trust and backtracking; score each target before assimilation; no refitting or selection by future truth
measurements: all 225 prediction residuals per case by axis and 25-row interval
post-update bootstrap and recent-cache physical RMSE and normalized group Huber losses
checkpoint parameter/norm arrays every 25 updates and at completion

interpretation.initialization: Exact equality of first predictions and all shared initial head/norm arrays excludes a pre-existing shared-head fit difference, but not subsequent optimization sensitivity
interpretation.memory_decomposition: Baseline -> no-feedback -> current-only isolates removing nonlinear feedback then removing lag inputs to the memory projection. Current-only -> matched-projection accumulator adds exponential memory and learned time constants with shared current-drive initialization. Matched-projection -> candidate changes initial projection scale only. Effects are path-dependent, not additive causal main effects
interpretation.optimizer: Compare 16 vs 64 iterations within each architecture; additional budget that improves training and forecasts supports solver underconvergence, while better cached fit with worse forecasts supports online generalization/regularization issues
interpretation.scope: Exploratory diagnosis on the two already inspected tapes, not new holdout evidence or an adoption gate. Preserve all arms and failures. No production API or model changes and no speed claim. If results do not isolate a cause, report uncertainty rather than invent a mechanism
